name: Chapter 1: Units and Measurement
description: SI base units, significant figures, rounding, error in results, dimensions, dimensional analysis and unit conversion

name: Chapter 2: Motion in a Straight Line
description: Displacement, velocity, acceleration, x-t and v-t graphs, equations of motion, free fall, relative velocity

name: Chapter 3: Motion in a Plane
description: Vectors, resolution, addition, motion in a plane, projectile motion, relative velocity, uniform circular motion

name: Chapter 4: Laws of Motion
description: Inertia, Newton’s three laws, momentum, impulse, equilibrium, friction, banking, free-body diagrams, lifts and pulleys

name: Chapter 5: Work, Energy and Power
description: Dot product, work, kinetic energy, work-energy theorem, potential energy, springs, conservation of energy, power, collisions

name: Chapter 6: Systems of Particles and Rotational Motion
description: Centre of mass, cross product, torque, angular momentum, equilibrium, moment of inertia, rotational kinematics and dynamics, rolling

name: Chapter 7: Gravitation
description: Kepler’s laws, universal gravitation, G, variation of g, gravitational potential energy, escape speed, satellites and their energy

name: Chapter 8: Mechanical Properties of Solids
description: Elasticity, stress and strain, Hooke’s law, stress-strain curve, Young’s, shear and bulk moduli, Poisson’s ratio, elastic energy, applications

name: Chapter 9: Mechanical Properties of Fluids
description: Pressure, Pascal’s law, hydraulics, continuity, Bernoulli’s principle, Torricelli, lift, viscosity, Stokes’ law, surface tension, capillarity

name: Chapter 10: Thermal Properties of Matter
description: Temperature scales, ideal gas, thermal expansion, specific heat, calorimetry, change of state, latent heat, conduction, convection, radiation, Newton’s cooling

name: Chapter 11: Thermodynamics
description: Zeroth law, internal energy, heat and work, first law, Cp − Cv, state variables, isothermal and adiabatic processes, second law, Carnot engine

name: Chapter 12: Kinetic Theory
description: Molecular nature of matter, gas laws, pressure of an ideal gas, kinetic interpretation of temperature, rms speed, equipartition, specific heats, mean free path

name: Chapter 13: Oscillations
description: Periodic and oscillatory motion, SHM, phase, reference circle, velocity and acceleration, force law, energy, spring systems, simple pendulum

name: Chapter 14: Waves
description: Transverse and longitudinal waves, wave equation, wave speed on strings and in gases, superposition, reflection, standing waves, pipes, beats
